The '''Knights''' are an {{2|Elites|Elite}} encounter found in {{2|Glory}}, featuring three knights fighting together.

== Flail Knight ==
{{Enemy Infobox
|Name   = Flail Knight
|Link   = Slay the Spire 2:Knight Gang#Flail Knight
|Image  = StS2_Mysterious Knight.png
|HP     = 101
|AscHP  = 108
|Debut  = Glory
|Type   = Elite
}}
=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|Flail Knight}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Breaker
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains 3 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Flail
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (9;{{Asc2|9|10}}) damage ×2.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Ram
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (15;{{Asc2|9|17}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Opens with {{Int2|Flail Knight|Ram}}, then randomly uses {{Int2|Flail Knight|Breaker}}, {{Int2|Flail Knight|Flail}}, or {{Int2|Flail Knight|Ram}} each turn. {{Int2|Flail Knight|Breaker}} cannot be used two turns in a row. 

{{Clear}}

== Spectral Knight ==
{{Enemy Infobox
|Name   = Spectral Knight
|Link   = Slay the Spire 2:Knight Gang#Spectral Knight
|Image  = StS2_Spectral Knight.png
|HP     = 93
|AscHP  = 97
|Debut  = Glory
|Type   = Elite
}} 
{{Power Infobox
|Name         = Hex
|Image        = StS2 Icon Hex.png
|Description  = While Spectral Knight is alive, ALL your cards are {{KW2|Ethereal}}.
|Type         = Debuff
|Stacks       = Does not stack
|BetweenTurns = Conserved
|GivesToPlayer = Hexed, Ethereal
}}
=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|Spectral Knight}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Hex
|Intent = Debuff
|Effect = Applies {{BD2|Hex}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Hex
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Soul Slash
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (15;{{Asc2|9|17}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Soul Flame
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals (3;{{Asc2|9|4}}) damage ×3.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Opens with {{Int2|Spectral Knight|Hex}}. After that, alternates between {{Int2|Spectral Knight|Soul Slash}} and {{Int2|Spectral Knight|Soul Flame}}.

{{Clear}}

== Magi Knight ==
{{Enemy Infobox
|Name   = Magi Knight
|Link   = Slay the Spire 2:Knight Gang#Magi Knight
|Image  = StS2_Magi Knight.png
|HP     = 82
|AscHP  = 89
|Debut  = Glory
|Type   = Elite
}} 
{{Power Infobox
|Name         = Dampen
|Image        = StS2 Icon Dampen.png
|Description  = While Magi Knight is alive, ALL your cards are Downgraded.
|Type         = Debuff
|Stacks       = Does not stack
|BetweenTurns = Conserved
}}
=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|Magi Knight}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Power Shield
|Intent = Attack1, Defend
|Effect = Deals (6;{{Asc2|9|7}}) damage. Gains (5;{{Asc2|8|9}}) {{KW2|Block}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Block
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Dampen
|Intent = Debuff
|Effect = Applies {{BD2|Dampen}}. While Magi Knight is alive, all your cards are Downgraded.
|GivesToEnemy = Dampen
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Ram
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals (10;{{Asc2|9|11}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Prep
|Intent = Defend
|Effect = Gains (5;{{Asc2|8|9}}) {{KW2|Block}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Block
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Magic Bomb
|Intent = Attack4
|Effect = Deals (35;{{Asc2|9|40}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Starts with {{Int2|Magi Knight|Power Shield}}, followed by {{Int2|Magi Knight|Dampen}}.
Then repeatedly uses {{Int2|Magi Knight|Ram}}, {{Int2|Magi Knight|Prep}}, and {{Int2|Magi Knight|Magic Bomb}} in that order.


{{Clear}}

== Notes ==
* Since {{C2|Nightmare}} creates cards at the start of your turn, upgraded cards duplicated by {{C2|Nightmare}} are not affected by {{BD2|Dampen}}.

== Trivia ==
* The {{Int2|Spectral Knight|Hex}} move technically applies 2 stacks of {{BD2|Hex}}. Since {{BD2|Hex}} does not stack this has no additional effect.
